name: sepsis_hybrid
description: Hybrid sepsis: the event-free BioGears SBML core (Tellurium) with its discrete events lifted into the vivarium layer as viva-impulse Steps — a ScheduledEvent for the timed infection (E_infect) and a ThresholdSwitch for the TLR hysteresis (E_tlrOn/Off), coupled via TelluriumImpulseBridge. Emits the 9 shared observables and reproduces the full event-driven model (to the tick-quantization of the infection timing). Healthy at severity 0.

infection_start_s.description: Infection start time (s); the ScheduledEvent fires at the first tick >= this
